headline: Saregama India Limited: Other Restructuring
sum: Other Restructuring - Saregama India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its Meeting held today, i.e., Wednesday, 4th November, 2026, has considered and approved Voluntary liquidation of Kolkata Metro Networks…
detail: Other Restructuring - Saregama India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its Meeting held today, i.e., Wednesday, 4th November, 2026, has considered and approved Voluntary liquidation of Kolkata Metro Networks Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
